companyDescription: Whole US market in one fund — ~3,600 large/mid/small caps. 0.03% cost, maximum diversification. The default DCA core.
priceNote: กระจายสุด ~3,600 ตัว ค่าธรรมเนียม 0.03% — แกน DCA ดีฟอลต์
summary: VTI owns essentially the entire US stock market (~3,600 companies) at a rock-bottom 0.03% expense ratio — the broadest, most diversified single-fund DCA core you can buy. Slightly richer broad-market valuation keeps it just behind SCHD, but it is the textbook hands-off accumulation vehicle.

catalysts.name: Whole-market compounding
catalysts.description: Captures the entire US market's long-run growth + dividends with near-zero cost drag.

risks: Cap-weighted — top mega-caps dominate, so concentration creeps in at the top
Falls with the broad market in any correction (no defense)
Broad-market valuation is somewhat elevated near highs

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Broad market is rate-sensitive at the margin but diversified across sectors.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Equities broadly outpace inflation over long horizons.
macroRisk.summary: Low Fed sensitivity via full diversification — the all-weather market proxy.

valuationBand.basis: Broad US-market forward P/E modestly above its long-run average; price near all-time highs

qualityScore.note: Total-market breadth (~3,600 names), 0.03% cost, modest yield, $661B AUM / Vanguard.

bands.label: Wait
bands.note: above fair — keep DCA, skip extra

dcaPlan.note: The default core — DCA monthly regardless of level; this is the 'set and forget' anchor.

technicalNote.note: Above a rising 200-DMA near all-time highs — long-term uptrend intact.

thesisBreak: Expense ratio materially raised or fund wound down
Index methodology change away from total-market coverage

entryStrategy.verdict: The whole-market default — broadest diversification at 0.03%. DCA monthly, forever.
